lines.t:
A type of <c:ffff00>stat<c> for <c:ffff00>head<c> and <c:ffff00>arm<c> <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>.

Measures the speed of physical preparations such
as loading ammo, including the efficiency of the
energy charging an <c:ffff00>act<c> requires.

The higher the value, the less time the <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> of an
<c:ffff00>action<c> takes.
